caption: The drawing depicts a three-seater bench with a slightly curved back and arms, rendered in black with floral decoration. The bench has a rectangular seat divided into three sections, each adorned with painted images of flowers in red, pink, white, and green tones. The upper backrest consists of a solid rail with horizontal slats below, decorated with similar floral patterns, and a central support featuring a carved or painted floral motif. Both the front and sides of the bench’s frame are outlined with fine yellow or gold lining, and the surfaces are detailed with multicolored flowers along the top rail, arm panels, and the front apron. The bench stands on four straight, slightly splayed legs. The background of the image is plain, with the bench shown casting a light gray shadow. The overall color composition highlights black as the dominant color, contrasted by the lighter and brighter colors of the flowers and gold edging.
title: Black Painted Settee
